name: Morse code
description: See a character, tap it out in dots and dashes; checked by script, then the right code blinks back. Handles prosigns and codes up to nine elements.
author: Joao Henrique Costa Araujo

types.name: Morse code
types.description: See a character, tap it out in dots and dashes; checked by script, then the right code blinks back. Handles prosigns and codes up to nine elements.

fields.name: letter
fields.description: The letter, digit, sign or prosign to send.

fields.name: name
fields.description: What it's called, shown under it (Full stop, End of contact). Optional.

fields.name: prosign
fields.description: Draw it with a bar on top: a prosign is sent as one run, with no gap between its letters.

fields.name: mnemonic
fields.description: A memory hook, shown after answering.

template.html:
Tap it out
{{letter}}
{{#name}}
{{name}}
{{/name}}

types.demo:
// An example answer for watch mode: the right code.
return String(key.code ?? "");

decks.name: Morse code::Punctuation
decks.description: The ITU signs, plus ! & ; _ and the dollar sign, which aren't in the standard.

decks.name: Morse code::Prosigns
decks.description: Procedure signals: letters run together with no gap, drawn with a bar on top.

fields.mnemonic: **O**h-oh-oh: three long tones. The other half of SOS.
**S**ss: three quick hisses. Half of SOS.
I M I: short short, long long, short short.
fields.name: Question mark

fields.mnemonic: S O S with no gaps: three short, three long, three short in one run.
fields.name: Distress
